data.title: 玛露希尔 · 睡前的编发准备
data.description: 营地睡袋旁，她对着小镜子为明天编新的发型，手指灵活地穿梭；第二天大家会不会注意到——怀着这种小小期待入睡。

data.promptProse: Marcille Donato sits beside the rolled camp sleeping bag, using both hands to braid her blonde hair while checking the small mirror propped against her pack. Spare ribbons wait on a folded cloth beside her cream knit top and comfortable brown trousers. The medium portrait includes the personal working area and darker camp background. Warm lamplight illuminates pointed ears, hopeful green eyes and lifted hair strands, with fine ribbon shadows across the cloth.
